description: Replace the company's sync rules. Pass the FULL rule set (fetch with get_sync_rules first and edit it - this is not a partial update), [] to disable rules, or null to opt into the inherited SaaS/ecommerce platform preset. Each rule: { triggerEvent, actions: { addTags, removeTags }, conditions? }. Conditions support requiresTags, requiresNotTags, and purchasedProduct ({ tags?, collectionIds?, productTypes?, vendors? }) which matches products on commerce events - e.g. tag buyers of products carrying a given product tag.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

syncRules.description: Full replacement rule set. Use [] to disable sync rules, or null to opt into the inherited SaaS/ecommerce platform preset.

purchasedProduct.description: For commerce events with product context: rule only applies when a product on the event matches every specified selector.

requiresNotTags.description: Rule only applies if the subscriber has NONE of these tags.

requiresTags.description: Rule only applies if the subscriber has ALL of these tags.

triggerEvent.description: Event name that triggers the rule, e.g. ecommerce.order_placed or saas.purchase.

name: update_sync_rules

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_sync_rules` MCP tool.

isDefault.description: Whether the company now uses the inherited SaaS/ecommerce platform preset.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

syncRules.description: Effective sync rules after the update.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
